subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt/rebase the open fork PR for the Debug Snapshots fix, or close that path and allow a fresh narrow fix from this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-proven, but an open fork PR still references this issue with closing syntax, so automation should not create a duplicate fix until maintainers choose the PR path.

options.title: Close fork path and queue a fresh fix
options.body: Close or supersede the fork PR, then let a new narrow Control UI fix address this issue against current main with localized copy, tests, and visual proof.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the fork branch and repair it against the current Debug page split before review.

recommendation.title: Close fork path and queue a fresh fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the fork PR, then let a new narrow Control UI fix address this issue against current main with localized copy, tests, and visual proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history on the Debug controller/view surface and Control dashboard wiring touched by this fix.
